content: {"summary":"The app frequently loses its playback controls, causing music to play without pause or skip options, forcing users to close or restart the app to regain control. [#rv_3749779709334236975] The issue appears after updates, with the bottom bar and notification controls disappearing, especially during workouts or driving, making it hard to manage playback. [#rv_-6984786771669701712] Users report that even offline mode suffers from random stops and missing controls, leading to frustration and forced app restarts. [#rv_501625458223378572]"}
